transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well, what really made me come in today is... I'm having this issue at work. I'm a buyer, and I just can't shake the feeling that people at my job, and even some of the vendors we use, are tracking my buys. 

It really seems like they're messing with the launch numbers on purpose just to make me look stupid. My supervisor actually sat down and showed me the reports to say there's no proof of that happening, but... I don't know, I just can't stop thinking that they are.

Can you tell me more about these feelings that people are tracking your work and trying to make you look bad? Do you feel this is happening because of a specific reason, or do you just somehow know it's happening?

I'm not really sure why they'd want to do it, honestly. I just... I just know it's happening. Like I said, it's just this constant feeling that they're all watching my buys. The vendors, the people I work with... they're changing the launch numbers to set me up so I look like an idiot. 

My supervisor sat me down and went through all the spreadsheets to show me that the numbers haven't been touched, but... I don't know. Even when I'm looking right at his reports, I just know they're still doing it. I can't really explain the 'why' part, I just know they are.
Outside of work, do you ever feel like people are watching you or trying to harm you in some way?

No, not really. It's just at work. I don't feel like anyone's following me home or watching me when I go to the store or anything like that. And I don't think anyone's trying to physically hurt me. It's just... it's just the stuff with my buys and the numbers at the office. Outside of that, everything feels pretty normal.
Have you ever had thoughts that others would find strange or hard to understand, even if they weren't related to your work?

No, I don't think so. I mean, nothing that stands out. It's really just this thing at work with the numbers and the vendors. Outside of that, I don't have any weird thoughts or anything that people wouldn't get. Everything else is pretty regular.
